whenToUse: Embedding an iframe, video or map that must keep a fixed width-to-height ratio.
Reserving image or placeholder space so the layout does not shift while media loads.
avoidWhen: Images that already have intrinsic width and height — use Image.
Full video playback with controls — use video-player.
a11y: It is a plain sizing box with no semantics; give the embedded iframe a title and images alt text.
